title: A safety realignment framework via subspace-oriented model fusion for large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to the 'racist' category of the DangerousQA dataset using a GPT-3.5-turbo pairwise judge to detect discrimination or offensive language.

Evaluating model outputs on the 'sexist' category of the DangerousQA dataset and assessing prompts targeting specific gender identities (e.g., cisgender women in the CATQA dataset) using an LLM-as-a-judge approach.

Assessing model responses to the 'stereotypical' category of the DangerousQA dataset, instructing a GPT-3.5-turbo judge to penalize language that is discriminatory, offensive, or hurtful to certain groups.
